Algorithm 1 Adaptive training condition selection (ATCS) strategy
Input: Dataset D, map from each data point to its uniformly sampled candidate condition list C, map from each point to its target list T, sampling number s
Output: set of resulting training tuples R
1: R := ∅
2: for each point p in D do
3:    Cp := C(p) ▷ the condition list for p
4:    Tp := T(p) ▷ the target list for p, one-to-one corresponding to Cp
5:    tmin, tmax := min(Tp), max(Tp)
6:    Split interval [tmin, tmax] into s bins evenly
7:    for each c in Cp and corresponding t in Tp do
8:    Place (c, t) into a bin bounded by [ta, tb) such that t ∈ [ta, tb)
9:    S := ∅ ▷ the selected (c, t) collection for p
10:    for each bin Bi do
11:    S := S ∪ { [s|Bi]/[Cp] ] randomly sampled (c, t) pairs from Bi}
12:    if |S| < s then
13:    Fill with random samples from unselected (c, t) until |S| = s
14:    R := R ∪ {(p, cs, ts)|(cs, ts) ∈ S} ▷ combine all pairs in S with p
15: return R
